packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-14 - unverified image reading (first reader)

Exposure note: nothing in my context proposes an identification or reading of this fragment. The brief's directory names indicate only the collection/batch (Stams fragments); the overviews themselves carry a modern pencil shelfmark label ("Stams, StA, Frg. 258r" on image-001, "...Frg. 258v" on image-005). I did nothing beyond the brief's rules.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001 and image-005, reduced overviews)

Observations:
- Object: a narrow horizontal strip of parchment (c. 13 x 3.5 cm by the scale), assembled from several pieces mounted on/with translucent repair tissue; grey tissue patches fill gaps. Several pieces appear differently toned (one darker brown rectangle centre-right on image-001; left and centre pieces on image-005), so the strip may be a composite of separate scraps, possibly not all in their original positions.
- Face A = image-001 (labelled "...258r"): about 3 lines of dark-brown text across the upper half (left to centre), a large red initial S at centre with a red rubric line beside it to the right (red letters "...ndia..."?), then lower half: faint brown text, some red letters at about centre-left (a red word after "...upl..."?), and paragraph-like marks at the left edge of the lower piece. Right third: mostly blank/abraded parchment, darker inserted patch.
- Face B = image-005 (labelled "...258v"): upper band with faint text (one word "...ticulas" at right, "...rsu" at far right edge), a band of red/orange-stained text across the middle (rubric or stained text), and in the lower right 3 lines of clear brown text in a gothic book hand, which in the overview look like "... est ... qui ... ret quod" / "...um est libera me domine ... pone me ..." / "...". 
- No column boundary is certain; the strip is too narrow to show column structure or margins reliably. No running title visible. Glosses not observed at overview scale.
- Tiles: image-002/003/004 appear to be native-resolution tiles of face A (left/centre/right), image-006/007/008 of face B.

Tentative interpretation: liturgical or devotional text in a textualis hand with red rubrics and red initials. Not inferring further.

FACE A

image-002 (left tile of face A; native resolution). Crops: crop-01.jpg (upper text, contrast), crop-02.jpg (lower piece, contrast).
Two distinct scripts/pieces: an upper band in a larger textualis (3 lines visible, left scrap + adjoining middle scrap separated by a tissue seam at x~640; continuity across the seam not certain), and a lower piece (below a horizontal tissue seam at y~500) in a smaller, very abraded hand, with a vertical seam at x~610.

Upper band (large script):
image-002 l.1: custodia | n(?)[.]b[.]dar[.] [illegible] (red dot/stroke at far right, x~1210)
image-002 l.2: q(uo)d' com(m)i | a • ostr(?) / osti(?) (con)?gin(?) [superscript stroke over g] fid[...]
   (the sign after "a" is a blot or punctus, not certain; "fid..." continues onto image-003)
image-002 l.3: tota(?) / toti(?) [...] (only first letters; rest abraded; faint brownish letters to the right at y~470, illegible)

Lower piece (small script, heavily abraded; lines counted from the top of the lower piece):
image-002 l.4 (y~540): [illegible traces]
image-002 l.5 (y~660): [..]m[...] corp(?)[...]  [illegible]  [..]n sup(er)(?)/ sup[...] (continues onto image-003 where a red word follows)
image-002 l.6 (y~730): [..]d(?) [illegible] [..]n[.] [illegible]
image-002 l.7 (y~800): [..]m[..]  [..]ani(?) [..]  [...]ra(?) mea a corp/corg[...]
image-002 l.8 (y~870): [..]tu(?) [illegible] [..]a(?) [illegible]
image-002 l.9 (y~940, cut by lower edge): [..] [..]de[...] [...]i[..]h(?)[...]
Left edge of lower piece: letters at line starts (l.6 "d"/"t", l.7 "m", l.8 "t") look like they belong to the text column; possibly a column's left margin at x~440.
Pencil marks on tissue at far left (modern?), illegible.

image-003 (centre tile of face A; overlaps image-002 by roughly the right 350 px of image-002: image-003 x~0-330 repeats image-002 x~1000-1338 - lines below are the same lines as image-002 l.1-9, not new text). Crops: crop-03.jpg (upper, greyscale), crop-05.jpg (upper, colour contrast), crop-04.jpg (lower, greyscale).

Upper band, continuing image-002 l.1-3:
image-003 l.1 (y~180): [..]r(?) [two red dots stacked vertically, like a red colon, at x~150] u(?)[.] [.]llapsa(n/m)(?) [-]   (the word looks like "...llapsa" + final n or a with a stroke; ends at a seam/edge at x~750)
image-003 l.2 (y~300): (con)?gin(?) fida[..] ue(?)[...] [illegible abraded, dark staining] (to x~760)
image-003 l.3 (y~470): faded orange-brown letters, apparently text whose ink has largely gone (or a faded rubric?); [illegible] - a few minims only
A dark horizontal crease/stain line at y~510 runs along the lower edge of this band.

Large red initial S at x~840-1070, y~190-510, spanning the upper band's lines 1-3 (two-line+ initial). Pencil marks (modern) scribbled inside the upper bowl of the S.
To the right of the S, on a separate darker scrap (x~930+):
image-003 l.1r (y~200), red rubric: Omeli[a](?) / Omelia(?) [continues on image-004]
   (first letter is a round O-like form; then m e l/c h-like; I read "Omel..." tentatively)
image-003 l.2r (y~320): black text, very faint: [.] [.]a [.]i [.]s [...] - letters only as dots/minims; [illegible]

Lower piece (small script), continuing image-002 l.5-9:
image-003 l.5 (y~660): [..]n lnps(?) / lups(?) e[..] followed by a red word/letters "tu(?)" at x~420 then a dark letter "V"/"v" at x~600 (?)
image-003 l.6 (y~740): [illegible traces]
image-003 l.7 (y~810): [...]ea a corp(?)/corg(?) [letter with descender crossed - possibly p or g with abbreviation] nue(?)ni(?)t(?) me / nuenit me(?)   (word-division uncertain)
image-003 l.8 (y~870): [illegible]
image-003 l.9 (y~930): [..]i[.]h(?)l[..] [illegible] (cut by lower edge)
Right portion of lower band: grey repair tissue (x~640-1160) and a dark brown inserted scrap (x~1160+), no text visible on it at this resolution.

image-004 (right tile of face A; overlaps image-003: image-004 x~0-330 = image-003 x~1150-1481). Crop: crop-06.jpg (rubric area, colour contrast).

Scrap to the right of the red S (same lines as image-003 l.1r-2r):
image-004 l.1r (y~200), red: [O]melia · v · b(?)/d(?)[.] [cut at seam x~630]
   -> combined with image-003: "Omelia · v · b[..]" (red; "Omelia" tentative - letters m, e (or c), l, i, a are clear on this tile; first letter only on image-003, round O-like; "v" set between two red points; then a b- or d-like letter and one more red stroke)
image-004 l.2r (y~330), black text with red touches on several letters: [.]a(?)[red-touched letter] [.]i(?)[red-touched] [.]s ille co(?)[.]/ cu(?)[...]   (I read "...s ille" clearly; preceding letters only as red-filled bowls/strokes; the red touches look like rubrication of letters, perhaps a lection opening, but that is interpretation)
image-004 l.3r (y~470): [illegible faint traces]
Right part (x~650-1300): separate pale scrap with modern pencil label "Stams, STA, Frg. 258r"; no medieval text visible on it; lower right darker scrap, no legible text (some faint curved strokes, not resolvable).
Lower left (x~0-490, y~540-860): dark brown inserted scrap; no legible text.

End of face A. Face A summary of what was selected: all visible text on face A was attempted; legible spans are the upper large-script band (3 lines, left to centre), the rubric "Omelia..." with the following black line, and the lower small-script piece (lines with "...n sup/lnps... [red] tu" and "...ea a corp... nuenit me"). Unread: lower small-script lines l.4, l.6, l.8 (abraded beyond reading at this resolution).

FACE B

image-006 (left tile of face B). Crop: crop-07.jpg (faded red rubric; top half colour contrast, bottom half green channel).
Left part (x~50-700): pale scrap with modern pencil label "Stams, StA, Frg. 258v"; below it a band of dark brown/orange staining (x~50-610, y~360-560) and a lower pale area; no medieval text legible on the left scrap at this resolution (staining band may hide letters; none resolved).
Grey tissue at x~650-870 in lower half.
Upper right scrap (x~720-1338):
image-006 l.1 (y~160), faded red: [..]a(?)/ n(?) · v · adla(?)/ adlo(?)[...] [continues onto image-007]
   (letters faded to pink; "v" between two points is fairly clear; then a-d-l-a or similar, uncertain)
image-006 l.2 (y~290): [illegible] - very faint brown traces only
image-006 l.3 (y~420, in a reddish-brown stained band x~830-1338): [illegible]
Lower right scrap (x~870-1338, y~510-830): stained; dark letters at top left "s(?)e(?)[.]" at y~540; otherwise [illegible].

image-007 (centre tile of face B; overlaps image-006: image-007 x~0-330 = image-006 x~1000-1338, so the faded red letters at top left are the same rubric line as image-006 l.1). Crops: crop-08.jpg (upper band, colour contrast), crop-09.jpg (lower piece, colour contrast).

Upper band, left scrap (x~0-740):
image-007 l.1 (y~170), faded red: [..]adla(?)/adlau(?) [..]  (same line as image-006 l.1; continues to x~420)
A large faded red/pink letter form at x~440-650, y~150-380 (a faded red initial, shape not resolvable - possibly S- or Z-like; only fragments of strokes remain).
image-007 l.2 (y~300): [illegible faint traces]
image-007 l.3 (y~440, inside the orange-brown stained band): [..]e(?)[..] [.]ilia(?)/ illa(?) [..]   (x~100-540; letters dark on orange stain)

Upper band, right scrap (x~750-1481), larger script like face A's upper band:
image-007 l.1 (y~165): ā(?)onse/onfe(?)g(?)re(?)r[...] [...] - first word could be "a" with an overline followed by "onsec..." / "onfeg..."; I cannot settle it; further faint letters at x~1400 "u(?)d(?)"
image-007 l.2 (y~300): [illegible] [..]urs f[...] / [..]uas f(?)[...] (x~1100-1460; continues onto image-008)
image-007 l.3 (y~440, in stained band): [.]i(?)l(?)is(?)fai(?)m(?)ul(?) tro/tre[...]   - dark letters on orange stain; very uncertain letter-by-letter; continues to image-008

Lower piece (small script, x~520-1481; lines counted from top of piece):
image-007 l.4 (y~520): [illegible traces, a red dot at x~1300 near top edge]
image-007 l.5 (y~610): [....]dicium(?) sit / sist(?) q(?)ua/ gra(?)[.]a(?) pe[...]   ("...dicium" fairly clear: d-i-c-i-u-m; "sit" or "sist" uncertain; then a word beginning with q or g)
image-007 l.6 (y~680): [illegible traces; a dash-like mark at x~900 and small strokes under "sit"]
image-007 l.7 (y~770): [..]iustum(?) / [..]ustum est libera me domi[ne](?)   ("est libera me" clear; "domi" visible, rest on image-008)
image-007 l.8 (y~850): [illegible]
image-007 l.9 (y~910, at lower edge): [..]x(?)[.] [.]equunt(?)/ sequu(n)t(ur)(?) uil(?)/ uel(?) me [.]ilat(?)/ [..]sbanc(?)[...]  (lower parts of letters cut by edge; "me" fairly clear)
Left part below the stained band (x~0-340): darker scrap, no legible text; grey tissue x~340-520.

image-008 (right tile of face B; overlaps image-007: image-008 x~0-330 = image-007 x~1150-1481). Crop: crop-10.jpg (lower lines, colour contrast). A grey card (photographic mask) covers the far lower right.

Upper band:
image-008 l.1 (y~150): [faint, illegible] ... and on the separate right scrap (x~710-1290): [.] u(er)su / uersu(m)(?)  ("rsu" with a stroke over u, or "uersū"; first letter partly lost)
image-008 l.2 (y~290): [..]urs f[..]  [...]  [.]rticulas   ("...rticulas" clear on the right scrap; the word before the seam is "[..]urs" or "[..]uas" + "f[..]", same as image-007 l.2)
image-008 l.3 (y~440, stained orange band): [..]ul ura(?) qr(?) h[.]u(?)[..] / ha(?)[..] ... (right scrap) [..]e(?)d(?) s[..](?)   (dark letters on stain, very uncertain)

Lower piece (small script; continuing image-007 l.4-9):
image-008 l.4 (y~510, partly under the tissue seam, red touch at x~30): [..] q(?)[...]m(?)mi[...]g(?)[..] - only tops of letters; [illegible]
image-008 l.4a (y~560): [illegible - stained, a few letters]
image-008 l.5 (y~630): [..] q(?)ua(?) pe(?)r(?)ui(?) [.]t(?) [.]buerit / fuuerit(?) quod
   -> with image-007 l.5: "[...]dicium sit(?) q/g[..]a pe[..] ... [.]buerit(?) quod"
image-008 l.7 (y~790): [..]me domine & / et(?) [letter blotted] pone me iuxta(?)
   -> with image-007 l.7: "[..]iustum(?) est libera me domine et(?) pone me iuxta(?)"  ("pone me" clear; "iuxta" read as i-u-x-t-a, the x not fully certain)
image-008 l.9 (y~905, lower edge): [..]atione(?)/ [..]lacione(?) contra m[...]
   -> with image-007 l.9: "[..]x[.] [.]equunt(?) uil(?) me [...]atione(?) contra m[..]"   (my reading of the image-007 portion is weak)

LIMITATIONS
- The strip is a composite of several scraps mounted on tissue; scraps differ in tone and script size (large textualis upper band vs. smaller textualis lower piece on both faces). Adjacency across seams is not proven; I joined words across seams only where noted and only as physical neighbours.
- Which face is recto/verso, and whether scraps on face A back the scraps on face B in their present positions, cannot be determined from these images.
- Much of face B's upper band is under brown/orange staining or faded red; face A's lower small-script piece is heavily abraded. Lines marked [illegible] reflect the surface, after contrast crops (crop-01..10).
- Red: face A has a large red initial S, a red rubric "Omelia · v · b[..]" (Omelia tentative), red touches on letters of the following line, a red colon-like double dot in the upper band, and a red word "tu(?)" in the lower piece. Face B has a faded red rubric "[..] · v · adla(?)[..]" and a faded red initial.
- Suggested further views: UV or multispectral imaging for face B's stained band and faded rubric; higher-magnification crops of face A lower piece lines 4, 6, 8.
- Stopped normally (not on the image limit); all 8 images were read.
